name: pnp-sharepoint-skills-knowledge-readiness-advisor
title: Knowledge Readiness Advisor
shortDescription: Assess SharePoint business knowledge for governance, quality, and Copilot readiness using an evidence-based six-dimension framework.
longDescription: Knowledge Readiness Advisor helps Modern Workplace consultants evaluate whether SharePoint business content is sufficiently governed, current, consistent, and reliable to support trustworthy AI and Copilot experiences.
The skill performs an executive assessment across six dimensions: Currency, Clarity, Consistency, Findability, Ownership, and AI Suitability.
It identifies conflicting guidance, outdated content, missing ownership, governance gaps, and AI readiness risks, then produces evidence-based recommendations and client workshop questions.
The assessment is designed for Knowledge Management and Copilot Readiness activities and does not provide formal certification or compliance approval.
